name: How to read this file
reading: Filter the section column. Each section is one layer of the same ontology: what exists, what it stores, how it connects, the rules that build the graph, then a worked sample. This revision is the plan to review before any code change.

name: What this revision changes
reading: BQ_Table is the physical table. It links to every BQ_column with HAS_COLUMN, and it stores use_case, project, and metadata. BQ_column is one node per physical column. BQ KPI Measure is a separate node with name, aggregation, and filters. It links to one BQ_Table and to the BQ_column nodes it uses. It does not copy the column catalog. LookML KPI Measure stays its own node. ReportingPeriod is not a node. YEAR and REPORTING_MONTH are ordinary columns, recognized by name and label.

name: Entities become nodes
reading: An ENTITY row is a node label. BQ_Table is one node. Each physical column is one BQ_column. Each BigQuery measure is one BQ_KPIMeasure. Each LookML measure is one LookMLKPIMeasure. Metric, Market, and the other vocabulary nodes are business terms. They are not copies of the columns.

name: Attributes become properties
reading: An ATTRIBUTE row is a field on a class. Every BQ_column has label, name, type, mode, format, description, table_details, metadata, provenance, and enum. A BQ KPI Measure has name, value_column, aggregation, and filters. SAMPLE_NODE fills those fields. A new month does not add a field.

name: Relationships become edges
reading: BQ_Table HAS_COLUMN BQ_column for every column. BQ_KPIMeasure ON_TABLE names the BQ_Table, and USES_COLUMN names the columns that measure aggregates or filters. LookMLKPIMeasure READS_COLUMN is the column named in sql. FILTERS_COLUMN points at the columns named by filter keys. The filter values stay on the measure node. Vocabulary nodes DESCRIBES_COLUMN the column they name.

name: One LookML node holds the measure
reading: type, sql, label, description, value_format_name, and filters are attributes of one LookMLKPIMeasure. Filters are not child nodes. The revenue measures in the sample show the shape. Any other measure is another node with the same attributes. The sample values are not a closed list.

name: Reporting period is the year and month columns
reading: YEAR and REPORTING_MONTH are the reporting period. The agent recognizes them from name, label, and description. format YYYY and format MM state the accepted values. There is no reporting_period attribute and no ReportingPeriod node. August 2025 is a filter value in BigQuery. The next month does not add a node.

name: Built for query-time column selection
reading: The agent reads the BQ_Table and the BQ_column nodes. metadata.column_role tells it which columns are dimensions, kpi measures, filters, or join keys. When a BQ KPI Measure matches the question, the agent starts from that measure's aggregation, filters, and linked columns, then adds any further columns the question still needs. It queries BQ_Table.name in the project on BQ_Table.project. The numbers come back from BigQuery. They are not stored on the graph.

name: What the graph no longer stores
reading: There is no ReportingPeriod node, no KPIObservation node, and no RiskProfile node. Row amounts, appetite, tolerance, and breach are columns the agent can select. A monthly extract adds rows in BigQuery. It does not add a period node or a second copy of YTD Actual.

name: BQ_Table
reading: Parent of every BQ_column through HAS_COLUMN. The agent reads name, project, and use_case from this node before it writes a query.

name: BQ column
applies_when: Always, one node per physical column
reading: One node per physical column of the BQ_Table. Dimensions, amounts, filters, and join keys are all columns. BQ_Table links to every column with HAS_COLUMN. The cell value is not stored here. This node is the column. The BQ KPI Measure is a separate node that points at the columns it uses.

name: BQ KPI Measure
applies_when: One node per BigQuery measure definition
reading: A query definition, not a physical column. It stores name, aggregation, and filters. ON_TABLE links it to one BQ_Table. USES_COLUMN links it to the BQ_column nodes it aggregates or filters. It does not copy every column. The full catalog stays on the BQ_Table. The revenue measures in the sample show the shape. Another measure is another node with the same attributes. The numeric result stays in BigQuery.

name: LookML KPI Measure
applies_when: One node per LookML measure definition
reading: Replaces the LookML half of KPIMeasure. One node holds type, sql, label, description, value_format_name, and filters. The three revenue measures are samples of that shape, not the full catalog.

name: Schema first
reading: Load one BQ_Table for agentic_kg_usecase and one BQ_column for every column in the schema. HAS_COLUMN links the table to each column. Reloading the schema updates those nodes. It does not create a second table or a second column of the same name.

name: Former KPIMeasure is split
reading: Do not create a KPIMeasure node. BQ_column is the physical column. BQ_KPIMeasure is the query definition: name, value_column, aggregation, and filters, linked to one BQ_Table and to the columns it uses. LookMLKPIMeasure is the LookML definition. A measure and a column that share YTD_ACTUAL stay two nodes, joined by USES_COLUMN or READS_COLUMN.

name: Reporting period is two columns
reading: Do not create a ReportingPeriod node. Do not create a node per month or per year. Do not add a reporting_period attribute. YEAR and REPORTING_MONTH already carry the period in name, label, and description. format YYYY and format MM tell the agent the accepted values.

name: Enum is not a node list
reading: Closed lists live in the enum attribute: markets SGH, UAE, INM, AOC, EXP, MYH, TWN, USA, and MEX; tiers L1, L2, and L3; units $, #, and %. Words such as 'such as' in a description do not become an enum. An open column keeps a blank enum.

name: LookML filters stay on the measure
reading: filters is one JSON attribute on the LookML node. Do not create a node for a filter value such as a source code or a metric name. FILTERS_COLUMN links the measure to the resolved columns only. source resolves to SOURCE. metric_name resolves to METRIC. Any other key matches a column name, ignoring case and treating underscores as optional.

name: New measures and new columns reuse the form
reading: A new LookML measure is a new LookMLKPIMeasure with the same attributes. A new BigQuery measure is a new BQ_KPIMeasure with name, value_column, aggregation, and filters. A new physical column is a new BQ_column under the same BQ_Table, linked with HAS_COLUMN. None of these changes adds a month node.

name: Vocabulary does not replace columns
reading: Metric, Market, Source, Segment, Channel, Product, MetricGroup, MetricLevel, Unit, and Corridor help the agent match words to filter values. Query construction reads BQ_Table, BQ_column, BQ_KPIMeasure, and LookMLKPIMeasure. A null channel, product, group, corridor, or segment does not create a vocabulary node.

name: Do not invent structure
reading: No region above a market. No link between different market codes. No ISO currency for $. No calculated breach. No recomputed variance. INDIA is not inferred as INM. Display text is preserved. Normalization is used only inside ids.

name: Agent column selection
reading: On a question, retrieve the BQ_Table and the columns whose label, name, description, enum, or metadata.column_role match the ask. If a BQ_KPIMeasure matches, use its value_column, aggregation, and filters, and follow USES_COLUMN. Add dimension, filter, and join-key columns the question still needs from the table's HAS_COLUMN edges. If the question names a period, include YEAR and REPORTING_MONTH. Those columns are recognized by name and label.

name: LookML narrows the columns
reading: If a LookMLKPIMeasure matches the question, read that one node. Follow READS_COLUMN for the amount column. Read filters for the predicates. Follow FILTERS_COLUMN for the columns those predicates apply to. Add any further columns the question still needs, using the same role rules. Do not load the rest of the catalog.

name: Then query BigQuery
reading: Build the query against BQ_Table.name. Use BQ_Table.project when it is set. Aggregate the measure's value_column with its aggregation. Apply the measure filters and the user's filters, including YEAR and REPORTING_MONTH when a period was requested. Execute the query and answer from the result. Do not write the result back onto the graph.

name: The graph does not grow with the calendar
reading: A new reporting month adds rows in agentic_kg_usecase only. YEAR and REPORTING_MONTH stay the same two column nodes. Their name and label do not change when a month is added.

name: Revenue YTD actual for a market and month
source_field: User question plus LookML measure revenue_ytd_actual
applies_when: Worked query, not a stored fact
reading: The user asks for Revenue year-to-date actual in one in-scope market for one month. The graph supplies the BQ KPI Measure, its aggregation sum, its value column YTD_ACTUAL, and its filters on SOURCE and METRIC. The question adds MARKET, YEAR, and REPORTING_MONTH from the BQ_Table columns. BigQuery returns the number. No period node is created.
